title: Privilege escalation to ALLOW_ADMIN: any user self-mints admin and drains any account via caller-named adminAccountId
root_cause: processAdminSetSignerPermissions trusts the attacker-supplied adminAccountId (never bound to the canonical admin account), and registration-time signer masks are not delegation-gated, so any user can self-mint ALLOW_ADMIN and then grant ALLOW_WITHDRAW on any victim.
attacker_entrypoint: REGISTER_ACCOUNT (self-mint ALLOW_ADMIN) -> ADMIN_SET_SIGNER_PERMISSIONS (grant ALLOW_WITHDRAW on victim) -> WITHDRAWAL
attacker_capabilities: register own account; submit permission + withdrawal transactions relayed by the batcher
out_of_scope_risks: bounded on-chain only by the trusted txBatcher/backend relaying the transactions

severity_justification.worst_case: Any user grants themselves withdraw rights on any account and drains all collateral => total loss of the permission model.
severity_justification.realistic_case: Same, gated on the trusted batcher relaying user-submitted permission txs.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: TipRun contest (tiprun-contracts-main @ d5d4d2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: REGISTER_ACCOUNT: attacker account A created with ALLOW_ADMIN session key (no delegation gate at registration)
ADMIN_SET_SIGNER_PERMISSIONS: adminAccountId=A (attacker's own), targetAccountId=victim, mask=ALLOW_WITHDRAW -> check passes (holds ALLOW_ADMIN on A)

state_transition.after: attacker holds ALLOW_WITHDRAW on victim; victim collateral drained to attacker

asset_delta: Victim collateral fully withdrawn to an attacker address.
false_positive_risks: on-chain impact gated by the trusted batcher; verify the live deployment relays user-supplied permission txs
invalidating_conditions: backend rejects self-named admin accounts or strips ALLOW_ADMIN at registration off-chain
ADMIN_SET_SIGNER_PERMISSIONS / REGISTER_ACCOUNT handlers not wired in the live deployment

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: the admin path (processAdminSetSignerPermissions) does not bind adminAccountId to the canonical admin, and registration masks are not delegation-gated

assumptions: the live batcher relays REGISTER_ACCOUNT, ADMIN_SET_SIGNER_PERMISSIONS and WITHDRAWAL transactions as signed
triager_summary: Caller-supplied adminAccountId trusted without binding to the canonical admin; combined with un-gated registration masks, any user self-mints ALLOW_ADMIN and drains any account. PoC passing (drains 5000).
